exposure: previous primary indication of cesarean delivery
outcome: successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
cohort: 406 patients who underwent a trial of labor after cesarean delivery between January 2012 and December 2016
finding: A modified score system, incorporating previous primary indication of cesarean delivery, previous vaginal birth history, maternal age, maternal weight gain, labor induction, pelvic/birth weight, and Bishop score, was developed and found to be a valid and useful tool for predicting successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery.
